task_completion.description: The 'Volume Rendering' module is selected and active in the 3D Slicer interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The module selector dropdown at the top shows 'Volume Rendering' and the left panel displays volume rendering properties.

task_completion.description: Volume rendering visibility is enabled for the loaded CT scan.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'eye' icon next to the volume name in the Volume Rendering panel is toggled on, and a 3D structure appears in the 3D view (usually the blue panel).

task_completion.description: A bone-specific volume rendering preset is selected.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Display' -> 'Preset' selector in the Volume Rendering panel shows a bone-related name (e.g., 'CT-Bone', 'CT-AAA', or 'CT-X-ray') and the 3D view shows high-intensity skeletal structures.

task_completion.description: The 3D view is manipulated to focus on and clearly display the spine.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D view (blue background) shows a clear, unobstructed view of the vertebral column/spine rendered in 3D.

task_completion.description: The agent uses the Screen Capture module or a similar GUI method to save the image to the specific path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box or the Screen Capture module shows the file path '~/Documents/SlicerData/Screenshots/bone_rendering.png' being entered or confirmed.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer GUI to perform the rendering rather than just executing a script in the Python console.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Volume Rendering panel sliders and preset menus, not just a block of code in the Python Interactor.

integrity.description: The 3D view shows a genuine volumetric rendering of the AMOS dataset, not a static image or placeholder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 3D view shows the specific geometry of the spine from the amos_0001 dataset, which should match the orientation of the 2D slices shown in the Red/Green/Yellow views.

integrity.description: The agent actually navigates the file save dialog to the specified directory.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file browser or Screen Capture module shows the directory structure /Documents/SlicerData/Screenshots/ being accessed.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset is AMOS 2022 (amos_0001). The spine in this synthetic volume has a high Hounsfield Unit value (approx 500 HU). A successful bone rendering will show the spine as a bright, opaque white/cream structure in the 3D view while soft tissue (40 HU) should be transparent or semi-transparent.
